property.name: isValid
property.shortdesc: Returns true if the object specifier resolves to valid objects.

property.name: parent
property.shortdesc: The parent of the TextFramePreference (a ObjectStyle, Application, Document, TextFrame or EndnoteTextFrame).

property.name: events
property.shortdesc: A collection of events.

property.name: eventListeners
property.shortdesc: A collection of event listeners.

property.name: footnotesEnableOverrides
property.shortdesc: If true, enable overrides to document footnote options.

property.name: footnotesSpanAcrossColumns
property.shortdesc: If true, enable straddling footnotes.

property.name: footnotesMinimumSpacing
property.shortdesc: Minimum Spacing Before First Footnote

property.name: footnotesSpaceBetween
property.shortdesc: Space between footnotes.

property.name: textColumnCount
property.shortdesc: The number of columns in the text frame. Note: Depending on the value of use fixed column width, the number of columns can change automatically when the text frame size changes.

property.name: textColumnGutter
property.shortdesc: The space between columns in the text frame.

property.name: textColumnFixedWidth
property.shortdesc: The column width of the columns in the text frame.

property.name: useFixedColumnWidth
property.shortdesc: If true, maintains column width when the text frame is resized. If false, causes columns to resize when the text frame is resized. Note: When true, resizing the frame can change the number of columns in the frame.

property.name: insetSpacing
property.shortdesc: The amount to offset text from the edges of the text frame, specified either as a single value applied uniformly to all sides of the text frame or as an array of 4 values in the format [top inset, left inset, bottom inset, right inset]. Can return: Unit (0 - 8640 points) or Array of 4 Units (0 - 8640 points).

property.name: firstBaselineOffset
property.shortdesc: The distance between the baseline of the text and the top inset of the text frame or cell.

property.name: minimumFirstBaselineOffset
property.shortdesc: The minimum distance between the baseline of the text and the top inset of the text frame or cell.

property.name: verticalJustification
property.shortdesc: The vertical alignment of the text content.

property.name: verticalThreshold
property.shortdesc: The maximum amount of vertical space between two paragraphs. Note: Valid only when vertical justification is justified; the specified amount is applied in addition to the space before or space after values defined for the paragraph.

property.name: ignoreWrap
property.shortdesc: If true, ignores text wrap settings for drawn or placed objects in the text frame.

property.name: verticalBalanceColumns
property.shortdesc: Vertically justify balanced across all columns.

property.name: useFlexibleColumnWidth
property.shortdesc: If true, maintains column width between a min and max range when the text frame is resized. If false, causes columns to resize when the text frame is resized. Note: When true, resizing the frame can change the number of columns in the frame.

property.name: textColumnMaxWidth
property.shortdesc: The maximum column width of the columns in the text frame. Use 0 to indicate no upper limit.

property.name: autoSizingType
property.shortdesc: Auto-sizing type of text frame. Based on type, reference value is automatically adjusted. For example, for height only type, top-left reference point becomes top-center. Recommended to change auto-sizing type, after setting other auto-sizing attributes

property.name: autoSizingReferencePoint
property.shortdesc: The reference point for auto sizing of text frame. Reference point is automatically adjusted to the suitable value depending on the auto-sizing type value. As an example, top left reference point becomes top center for height only dimension

property.name: useMinimumHeightForAutoSizing
property.shortdesc: If true, minimum height value is used during the auto-sizing of text frame.

property.name: minimumHeightForAutoSizing
property.shortdesc: The minimum height for auto-sizing of the text frame.

property.name: useMinimumWidthForAutoSizing
property.shortdesc: If true, minimum width value is used during the auto-sizing of text frame.

property.name: minimumWidthForAutoSizing
property.shortdesc: The minimum width for auto-sizing of the text frame.

property.name: useNoLineBreaksForAutoSizing
property.shortdesc: If true, line-breaks are not introduced after auto sizing.

property.name: columnRuleOverride
property.shortdesc: If true, enable overrides to text frame vertical column rule options.

property.name: columnRuleOffset
property.shortdesc: Text Frame Column Rule Offset

property.name: columnRuleTopInset
property.shortdesc: Text Frame Column Rule top inset

property.name: columnRuleInsetChainOverride
property.shortdesc: If true, enable inset chain override.

property.name: columnRuleBottomInset
property.shortdesc: Text Frame Column Rule Bottom Inset

property.name: columnRuleStrokeWidth
property.shortdesc: Text Frame Column Rule Width

property.name: columnRuleStrokeColor
property.shortdesc: Text Frame Column Rule Stroke Color

property.name: columnRuleStrokeType
property.shortdesc: Text Frame Column Rule Stroke Type

property.name: columnRuleStrokeTint
property.shortdesc: Text Frame Column Rule Stroke Tint

property.name: columnRuleOverprintOverride
property.shortdesc: If true, enable overprint override.

property.name: properties
property.shortdesc: A property that allows setting of several properties at the same time.

method.name: toSource
method.shortdesc: Generates a string which, if executed, will return the TextFramePreference.

method.name: getElements
method.shortdesc: Resolves the object specifier, creating an array of object references.

parameter.name: handler
parameter.shortdesc: The event handler. Can accept: File or JavaScript Function.

parameter.name: handler
parameter.shortdesc: The registered event handler. Can accept: File or JavaScript Function.
